Mittātherīgāthā Mittā (2nd) Verses of the Elder Mittā

“Cātuddasiṁ pañcadasiṁ, I rejoiced in the host of gods, “On the fourteenth day, on the fifteenth day, yā ca pakkhassa aṭṭhamī; having observed the sabbath on the eighth day of a fortnight, Pāṭihāriyapakkhañca, complete in all eight factors, and on extraordinary fortnights, aṭṭhaṅgasusamāgataṁ. on the fourteenth and the fifteenth days, I observed the Uposatha,

Uposathaṁ upāgacchiṁ, and the eighth day of the fortnight, complete in all its eight factors, devakāyābhinandinī; as well as on the fortnightly special displays. seeking delight in the company of Devas. Sājja ekena bhattena, Today I eat just once a day, Today with one meal a day, muṇḍā saṅghāṭipārutā; my head is shaven, I wear the outer robe. a shaven head, wrapped in a robe, Devakāyaṁ na patthehaṁ, I don’t long for the heavenly host, I do not aspire to be a Deva, vineyya hadaye daran”ti. for stress has been removed from my heart. as I have removed distress from my heart.”

… Mittā therī …. The Elder Mittā
